pages.title: Campaign Phases
pages.text: This entry follows mulan_tianlan_war.json and MULAN_TIANLAN_WAR.md. Four phases are available through daily world events: border_skirmish, fashi_array_clash, holy_beast_intervention, and ceasefire_or_escalation.

pages.title: Current Effects
pages.text: Border skirmishes and formation clashes are Mulan Grassland events that use trade_risk_up and rare_loot_hint to represent danger and battlefield rumors. Sacred bird intervention grants aura_plus_5 and secret_realm_ticket_hint, while ceasefire or escalation belongs to the Tianlan branch.

pages.title: Planned Content
pages.text: Choosing sides, Mulan/Tianlan/Tiannan reputation, grand spell-warrior formation objectives, sacred bird trials, war-merit rewards, and battlefield NPCs are not yet implemented. The corresponding native routes are projected in the FTB Quests chapter 'Mulan-Tianlan and the Six Demonic Sects'; native progress remains authoritative. This guide documents existing hooks without presenting unavailable rewards or faction consequences as finished gameplay.
